decisions.reason: As a newly launched marine lighting system in a niche B2B segment, its sales signal is still unfolding and a large incumbent can afford to keep this option open for another year.
The dedicated product page shows initial commitment, but as a desk lamp in a more competitive and less core-looking segment it faces higher pruning risk if traction stays weak.
Its own page and the 'G2' naming suggest an extension of an existing family, so uncertainty is lower and the firm is likely to continue backing it rather than abandon it quickly.
Because it is only briefly mentioned and sits in a crowded professional lighting category, it is a weaker option, but after just one year the firm would usually wait for more market feedback.
A marine HMI searchlight fits a specialized industrial niche where qualification and customer adoption take time, making continued market presence a relatively cheap option to preserve.
A marine searchlight is close to an established industrial lighting competence, and for a large mature German manufacturer the cost of keeping such a recent niche product available is likely modest.
